	function getOption(str,co){

  }

		yzm=java.getVerificationCode(code);
		url+=","+getOption(yzm,"");
		hm=java.ajax(url);
		co=java.getCookie(url,"g3jy9sqo0ws");
   source.setVariable(yzm+',g3jy9sqo0ws='+co)
   return hm;
  }
	if(yzco&&yzco!=''){
		v=String(yzco).split(',');
		u=url+","+getOption(v[0],v[1]);
		result=java.ajax(u);
		if(/请输入验证码/.test(result)){
			java.longToast("  ！验证码过期或有误，重新获取  ！")
			result=succes();
		}

result

@js:
list=[]
$=result
for(i in $){
if(String($[i]).match(/class="volume/)){
	t=String($[i].text()).replace(new RegExp(book.name,''),'');
		list.push({
				text: "🏮〖"+t+"〗🏮",
				volume: true
			})
	}
else{
		$[i].select("a").forEach(a=>{
				list.push({
						text: a.text(),
						href: a.attr("href")
					})
			})
	}
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

ruleContent.content:
<js>
let d = JSON.parse(result);
let limit = Number(baseUrl.match(/limit=(\d+)/)[1]);
let commentTotal  =  Number(java.getString("$.data.commentTotal"));
let page = Math.ceil(commentTotal/limit);
let p = (Number(baseUrl.match(/offset=(\d+)/)[1])/limit)+1;
function getPlainText(cl) {
    let output = "";
    let cllen = cl.length;
    let sss = String(source.getVariable());
    let re = /^([\[\]橘糖紫糖]|嗑到了|kswl|\d+\.\d+\.\d+|[1234567890一二三四五六七八九十]+刷|打卡)+$|为营造更好的评论环境，/;
    let sre = sss.match(/屏蔽【(.*?)】/)?.[1] ?? null;
    sre = sre ? new RegExp(sre.replace(/,/g, '|'), 'g') : null;    
    let plen = 0;
    let validCount = 0;

    for (let i in cl) {
        let c = cl[i];
        let reply = (c?.replyAll ?? c?.reply);
        let rl = [];
        if (re.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody) : null)) {
            cllen--;
            plen++;
            continue;
        }
        
        // 处理回复
        let replyTotal = Number(c.replyTotal);
if(replyTotal > 5 && /◎缓存回复/.test(sss)) { 	
	let replyUrl = "https://android.jjwxc.net/comment/getReplyList";   
    let offset = 5;
    let limit = replyTotal; 
    let replyBody = `versionCode=444&novelId=${c.novelId}&chapterId=${c.chapterId}&commentId=${c.commentId}&offset=${offset}&limit=${limit}&isBackend=2&token=${getToken()}`;
        let replyPost = {
            "method": "POST",
            "body": replyBody
        }
        let replyList = java.ajax(replyUrl+","+JSON.stringify(replyPost));     
        replyList = JSON.parse(replyList).data;
        reply = reply.concat(replyList);                  
    }


        for (let j in reply) {
            let r = reply[j];
            if (re.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) || (sre ? sre.test(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody) : null)) {
                continue;
            }
            
            let authorTag = (r?.isAuthor === "1" ? "👑" : "📜")+r.floor+"楼 ";
            
            rl.push({
                text: `${authorTag} ${r.replyAuthor ?? r.commentauthor} (${(!r.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(r.comment_date_time *1000)) ?? (r.replyDate || r.commentdate)})\n ${replaceEmoticons(r.replyBody ?? r.commentbody)}`
            });
        }
                               
        // 构建主评论
        let authorTag = "";
        if (c?.isAuthor === "1") {
            authorTag = "👑";
        } else if (c?.bulletinComment === "1") {
            authorTag = "📢";
        } else {
            authorTag = "👤";
        }

        // 主评论头部信息（作者、时间、订阅、互动数据）
             
        let header = `${authorTag} ${c.commentAuthor ?? c.commentauthor} `;
        let time = ` 📆${(!c.comment_date_time ? undefined : java.timeFormat(c.comment_date_time * 1000)) ?? (c.commentDate || c.commentdate || '')}`
        // 订阅信息     
        if (c.subscriptionicon) {
            if (c.subscriptionrate) {
                header += ` 📖${c.subscriptionrate}`;
            } else if (c.subscriptionicon.includes("rate_novelallbuy")) {
                header += ` 📖100%`;
            }
        }

        // 互动数据
        header += ` \n👍${c.agreenum ?? "0"}`;
        if (c.commentMark) header += ` ⭐️${c.commentMark}`;
        
        output += "\n"+header + time+ "\n";
        output += `${replaceEmoticons(c.commentBody ?? c.commentbody)}`;




        // 回复内容
        if (rl.length > 0) {
            output += "\n‎\n🔁 回复内容:\n";
            rl.forEach(reply => {
                output += `  ${reply.text}\n`;
            });
        }
        if(replyTotal > 5 && !/◎缓存回复/.test(sss)){
        output= output.replace(/\n$/,'')+getImage(replyTotal,c.novelId,c.chapterId,c.commentId)
        }
	
        output += "\n‎\n";
        validCount++;
    }

    // 添加统计信息
    let stats = `🏷本章共有${commentTotal}条评论 | 共有${page}页\n💬当前第${p}页显示 ${validCount} 条评论 | 屏蔽 ${plen} 条评论`;
      
    return stats + "\n\n" + output;
}
let msg = d?.data.commentTotal?null:d.message;
if(msg){
	java.toast(msg);
}else{
result = getPlainText(d.data.commentList);
if(/\d+-\d+/.test(book.getVariable("custom"))){
     if(/offset=0/.test(baseUrl)&&!/1-\d+/.test(book.getVariable("custom"))){
     	result = ""
     	}
}
result.replace(/</g,'<')
.replace(/>/g,'>')
}
</js>

variableComment:
1、设置书籍变量处可填写（只会应用于当前书籍）

  开始页-结束页  ——   如10-20 
则评论从第10页开始，第20页结束
默认最多从第1页至第10页结束

2、设置源变量处可填写（应用于所有书）

屏蔽【屏蔽词,屏蔽词,屏蔽词】 ——  如 屏蔽【磕到了,营养液】只要有屏蔽词就不显示此评论。
注意用英文逗号【,】分隔屏蔽词，【】符号不能少。

 ◎数量  ——  如 ◎1000 则每页显示1000条评论，默认为500，注意数字太大可能会失败。
 
◎回复 —— 评论按照回复时间排序，默认为点赞数排序

◎长评 —— 只显示长评
 
 ◎缓存回复 —— 更多回复加载到正文（填写后刷新正文，❗️注意：当前页有很多评论有更多回复，会导致正文加载速度非常慢！有500条更多回复就要请求500次！），不填写则是刷新图片可以查看更多回复，正文加载速度较快。
 
 注意◎符号不能少。
 
（更改完书籍变量或源变量一定要先刷新详情页，再刷新正文）

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

<js>
(function(){
    var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result, baseUrl);
    function trim(s){ return s ? String(s).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : ''; }
    function norm(s){ return trim(String(s || '').replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ').replace(/[ \t\r\f\v]+/g, ' ')); }
    function decodeTextLines(s){
        s = String(s || '').replace(/\r/g, '');
        var arr = s.split('\n');
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) arr[i] = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(arr[i]).text();
        return arr.join('\n');
    }
    function messageToText(msgEl){
        if (!msgEl) return '';
        var c = msgEl.clone();
        c.select('i.pstatus, script, style, rt, .quote, .pstatus, .aimg_tip, .jammer').remove();
        var rubies = c.select('ruby');
        for (var i = rubies.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) rubies.get(i).unwrap();
        var as = c.select('a');
        for (var j = as.size() - 1; j >= 0; j--) as.get(j).unwrap();
        var h = String(c.html() || '');
        h = h.replace(/<br[^>]*>/ig, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/<hr[^>]*>/ig, '\n\n');
        h = h.replace(/<li[^>]*>/ig, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/<\/(?:li|div|p|section|blockquote|article|header|footer|aside|tr|td|th|ul|ol|table|tbody|thead|tfoot)>/ig, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/<h[1-6][^>]*>/ig, '\n\n');
        h = h.replace(/<\/h[1-6]>/ig, '\n\n');
        h = h.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
        h = decodeTextLines(h);
        h = h.replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ');
        h = h.replace(/[ \t\f\v]+/g, ' ');
        h = h.replace(/ *\n */g, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
        return trim(h);
    }
    function linesFromMessage(msgEl){
        var txt = messageToText(msgEl);
        var raw = txt.split(/\n+/);
        var arr = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
            var line = norm(raw[i]);
            if (!line) continue;
            if (/^(本帖最后由|評分|评分|點評|点评|參與人數|参与人数|積分|积分|理由|查看全部评分)/.test(line)) continue;
            arr.push(line);
        }
        return arr;
    }
    function cleanThreadTitle(){
        var t = trim(doc.select('.view_tit').first().text());
        t = t.replace(/^\s*(?:[\[【][^\]】]{1,20}[\]】]\s*)+/g, '');
        t = t.replace(/[\[【](?:\d+[.\-/]\d+更新.*?|更新.*?|完结.*?|完結.*?)[\]】]\s*$/g, '');
        t = t.replace(/\s+\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\s*(?:\(\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\))?\s*$/g, '');
        return trim(t);
    }
    function firstMeaningful(lines, rawTitle, imgCount){
        if (imgCount >= 2) return rawTitle;
        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length && i < 16; i++) {
            var line = lines[i];
            if (/^(作品名稱|作品名称|作品名|書名|书名|標題|标题|題名|题名|原名|作者\s*[:：]?|原作\s*[:：]?|原著\s*[:：]?|翻譯\s*[:：]?|翻译\s*[:：]?|譯者\s*[:：]?|译者\s*[:：]?|校對\s*[:：]?|校对\s*[:：]?|圖源\s*[:：]?|图源\s*[:：]?|嵌字\s*[:：]?|漢化\s*[:：]?|汉化\s*[:：]?|簡介\s*[:：]?|简介\s*[:：]?|內容簡介\s*[:：]?|内容简介\s*[:：]?|原文简介\s*[:：]?|作品連結\s*[:：]?|作品链接\s*[:：]?|連結\s*[:：]?|链接\s*[:：]?|原地址\s*[:：]?|生肉\s*[:：]?|作品標籤\s*[:：]?|作品标签\s*[:：]?|主題\s*[:：]?|主题\s*[:：]?|目錄|目录|邊看邊翻|边看边翻|嚴禁劇透|严禁剧透)/.test(line)) continue;
            if (/^[0-9]{1,3}(后)?$/.test(line)) continue;
            if (line.length <= 1) continue;
            return line;
        }
        return rawTitle;
    }
    function isIntroCatalogPost(index, lines, msg){
        if (index != 0) return false;
        var tocLinks = msg.select("a[href*='goto=findpost'], a[href*='pid=']").size();
        if (tocLinks >= 2) return true;
        var joined = lines.join('\n');
        if (/(作品名稱|作品名称|作品名|書名|书名|作者|原作|原著|簡介|简介)/.test(joined) && /(目錄|目录|索引)/.test(joined)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function isChapter(name, text, imgCount){
        if (imgCount >= 2) return true;
        if (/^(前言|序章|后记|後記|番外|楔子|序|终章|終章|尾声|尾聲|最終話|最终话|第.{0,16}[话話章节章卷篇回]|[一二三四五六七八九十百零〇0-9]+[话話章节章卷篇回])/.test(name)) return true;
        if (text.length >= 180) return true;
        return false;
    }

    var list = [];
    var posts = doc.select('.plc.cl');
    var pageUrl = String(baseUrl || '').replace(/([?&])__pid=\d+/g, '$1').replace(/&&+/g, '&').replace(/#pid\d+$/g, '');
    var rawTitle = cleanThreadTitle();
    for (var i = 0; i < posts.size(); i++) {
        var post = posts.get(i);
        var pid = String(post.id() || '').replace(/^pid/, '');
        var msg = post.select('.message').first();
        if (!pid || !msg) continue;
        var lines = linesFromMessage(msg);
        if (isIntroCatalogPost(i, lines, msg)) continue;
        var text = lines.join('\n');
        var imgCount = msg.select('img').size();
        var name = firstMeaningful(lines, rawTitle, imgCount);
        if (!isChapter(name, text, imgCount)) continue;
        var url = pageUrl + (pageUrl.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + '__pid=' + pid + '#pid' + pid;
        list.push({name: name || rawTitle, url: url});
    }
    return list;
})();
</js>

<js>
if(result.match(/百度安全验证/)){
	xb=(baseUrl)+","+JSON.stringify({
		"headers":{
			"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86 64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/127.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}})
java.startBrowserAwait(xb,"验证")
result=java.ajax(xb)
	}

var bookList = [];
var finalJsonOutput = null;
try {
    var doc = result;
    if (!doc) {
        throw new Error("无法解析 HTML");
    }
    var containers = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(doc).select("div.c-container.result-op, div.c-container.result");
    java.log("找到 " + containers.size() + " 个");
    for (var i = 0; i < containers.size(); i++) {
        var container = containers.get(i);
        var book = {};
        if (container.hasClass("result-op")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " 个 (result-op)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;             
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                    //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var authorElement = container.selectFirst("span");
            if (authorElement) {
                var authorText = authorElement.text().trim();
                var prefix = "作者： "; 
                if (authorText.includes(prefix)) {
                    book.author = authorText.substring(prefix.length).trim();
                } else {
                    book.author = "未找到";
                    //java.log("作者信息未找到或格式不符: " + authorElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.author = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到作者对应的 span 标签");
            }            
            var introElement = container.selectFirst("div.text_2NOr6");
            var introText = null;
            if (introElement) {
                introText = introElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = introText;                 
                book.kind = null; 
                if (!introText.startsWith("简介:")) {
                    var kindPrefix = "类别:";
                    var kindIndex = introText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                    if (kindIndex !== -1) {
                        var kindTemp = introText.substring(kindIndex + kindPrefix.length).trim();
                        var chapterPrefix = "最新章节"; 
                        var chapterIndex = kindTemp.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                        if (chapterIndex !== -1) {
                            book.kind = kindTemp.substring(0, chapterIndex).trim(); 
                        } else {
                            book.kind = kindTemp; 
                        }
                    } else {
                        //java.log("未在 intro 文本中找到 '类别:' 用于提取 kind: " + introText);
                    }
                } else {
                    //java.log("intro 文本以 '简介:' 开头，kind 设为 null");
                }
            } else {
                book.intro = null; 
                book.kind = null;
                //java.log("未找到 intro/kind 对应的 div.text_2NOr6 标签");
            }            
            var allAElements = container.select("a");
            if (allAElements.size() >= 2) {
                book.lastChapter = allAElements.get(allAElements.size() - 2).text().trim();
            } else {
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                //java.log("a 标签数量不足，无法提取倒数第二个作为 lastChapter");
            }
        } else if (container.hasClass("result")) {            
            java.log("处理第 " + (i + 1) + " (result)");            
            book.bookUrl = container.attr("mu") || null;            
            var nameElement = container.selectFirst("a");
            if (nameElement) {
                var nameText = nameElement.text().trim();
                book.name = (nameText) ? nameText : "未找到";
                if (!nameText) {
                   //java.log("未找到书名，a 标签内容: " + nameElement.outerHtml());
                }
            } else {
                book.name = "未找到";
                //java.log("未找到书名对应的 a 标签");
            }            
            var contentRightElement = container.selectFirst(".content-right_1THTn");
            if (contentRightElement) {
                var fullText = contentRightElement.text().trim();
                book.intro = fullText;                 
                book.author = null; 
                var authorPrefix = "作者:"; 
                var authorIndex = fullText.indexOf(authorPrefix);
                var kindSeparator = "类别"; 
                var kindIndexForAuthor = fullText.indexOf(kindSeparator);
                if (authorIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = authorIndex + authorPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (kindIndexForAuthor !== -1 && kindIndexForAuthor > authorIndex) ? kindIndexForAuthor : fullText.length;
                    book.author = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '作者:'");
                }                
                book.kind = null; 
                var kindPrefix = "类别:"; 
                var kindIndex = fullText.indexOf(kindPrefix);
                var chapterSeparator = "最新章节"; 
                var chapterIndexForKind = fullText.indexOf(chapterSeparator);
                if (kindIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = kindIndex + kindPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (chapterIndexForKind !== -1 && chapterIndexForKind > kindIndex) ? chapterIndexForKind : fullText.length;
                    book.kind = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '类别:'");
                }                
                book.lastChapter = null; 
                var chapterPrefix = "最新章节:"; 
                var chapterIndex = fullText.indexOf(chapterPrefix);
                var updateSeparator = "最新更新"; 
                var updateIndex = fullText.indexOf(updateSeparator);

                if (chapterIndex !== -1) { 
                    var startIndex = chapterIndex + chapterPrefix.length;
                    var endIndex = (updateIndex !== -1 && updateIndex > chapterIndex) ? updateIndex : fullText.length;
                    book.lastChapter = fullText.substring(startIndex, endIndex).trim();
                } else {
                    //java.log("未在 .content-right_1THTn 中找到 '最新章节:'");
                }
            } else {                
                book.author = null;
                book.kind = null;
                book.lastChapter = null;
                book.intro = null;
                //java.log("未找到 .content-right_1THTn 元素");
            }
        } else {
            //java.log("跳过未知类型的容器: " + container.outerHtml().substring(0, 100));
            continue; 
        }        
        bookList.push(book);
    }
    var finalResult = {
        bookList: bookList 
    };
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify(finalResult);
} catch (e) {
    java.log("错误: " + e);
    finalJsonOutput = JSON.stringify({
        bookList: []
    }); 
}
result = finalJsonOutput;

        var line = parts[i].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (line) {
            if (/最新网址|m\.biqukun|本章未完.*继续阅读/.test(line)) continue;
            lines.push(line);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length > 0 && /^第\d+章/.test(lines[0])) {
        lines.shift();
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

                            },

                        };
                        let check_book_url = base_url + '/check_book_in_book_shelf,';

                        try {

                                    book_info['id'] = check_data.id;
                                    let uurl = base_url + '/update_book_shelf,';
                                    java.ajax(uurl + JSON.stringify(rop));
                                } else {
                                    java.ajax(rurl + JSON.stringify(rop));
                                }
                            } catch (e) {
                                java.log('书架操作失败:' + e);
                            }
                        }
                    }

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var html = String(result);
var d = html.match(/initTxt\("([^"]+)"/);
if (!d) '内容加载失败';
else {
    var u = d[1];
    if (u.indexOf('//') === 0) u = 'https:' + u;
    var s = String(java.ajax(u));
    var j = s.match(/_txt_call\((\{[\s\S]*\})\)/);
    if (!j) '解析失败';
    else {
        var c = j[1].match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"\s*,\s*"replace"/);
        if (!c) c = j[1].match(/"content"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"/);
        if (!c) '无content';
        else {
            var ct = c[1].replace(/\\n/g,'\n').replace(/\\r/g,'\r').replace(/\\t/g,'\t').replace(/\\"/g,'"').replace(/\\\\/g,'\\');
            var r = /"([^"]+)"\s*:\s*"((?:\\b|\\n|[\s\S]))"/g;
            var m;
            while ((m = r.exec(j[1])) !== null) {
                ct = ct.split(m[2]).join(m[1]);
            }
            ct = ct.replace(/&#x([0-9a-fA-F]+);/g, function(_, h) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)) });
            ct = ct.replace(/&#(\d+);/g, function(_, d) { return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(d, 10)) });
            var b = html.match(/ttf;base64,([^\)]+)/);
            if (b) try { ct = String(java.replaceFont(ct, java.queryBase64TTF(b[1]), java.queryTTF("https://alanskycn.gitee.io/teachme/assets/font/Source Han Sans CN Regular.ttf"), true)) } catch(e) {}
            ct = ct.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
            ct.split('\n').filter(function(l) { return l.trim() && !/AILISW|ailisw|温馨提示|加载中/.test(l) }).join('\n');
        }
    }
}
</js>

<js>
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result), baseUrl);
var arr = [];
var seen = {};
// 1. 封面推荐卡片 .col-md-6.mb-3
var cards = doc.select(".col-md-6.mb-3");
for(var i=0;i<cards.size();i++){
  var card = cards.get(i);
  var titleA = card.select("h6.book-title a").first();
  if(titleA == null) continue;
  var url = titleA.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = titleA.text().trim();
  var authorEl = card.select("p.book-author").first();
  var author = authorEl ? authorEl.text().replace("作者：","").trim() : "";
  var coverEl = card.select("img.book-cover").first();
  var cover = coverEl ? coverEl.attr("abs:src") : "";
  var introEl = card.select("p.book-desc").first();
  var intro = introEl ? introEl.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:cover, intro:intro});
}
// 2. 最新入库列表 ul.new-book-list li
var newItems = doc.select("ul.new-book-list li");
for(var i=0;i<newItems.size();i++){
  var li = newItems.get(i);
  var a = li.select("a").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var span = li.select("span").first();
  var author = span ? span.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:""});
}
// 3. 编辑推荐列表 ul.latest-list li
var latestItems = doc.select("ul.latest-list li");
for(var i=0;i<latestItems.size();i++){
  var li = latestItems.get(i);
  var a = li.select("a.latest-title").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var span = li.select("span.latest-author").first();
  var author = span ? span.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:""});
}
// 4. 最近更新表格 table.update-table tbody tr
var rows = doc.select("table.update-table tbody tr");
for(var i=0;i<rows.size();i++){
  var tr = rows.get(i);
  var tds = tr.select("td");
  if(tds.size() < 2) continue;
  var a = tds.get(0).select("a").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var author = tds.get(1).text().trim();
  var lastCh = tds.size() > 2 ? tds.get(2).text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:lastCh});
}
JSON.stringify(arr)

<js>
base = baseUrl;
id = baseUrl.match(/(\d+\/)/)[1]
java.put("id",id)
lis = java.getElements('#list-chapterAll@dd');
var list = [];

for (var i = 0; i < lis.length; i++) {
     var href = lis[i].select('a').attr('href');
     var text = lis[i].text();
     if (href==0) {
        if ( i < lis.length - 1 ) {
            var url = "https://www.baidu.com/" + id + lis[i + 1].select('a').attr('href');         
        } else {
            var url = "https://cn.bing.com/" + id + lis[i - 1].select('a').attr('href');
        }
     } else { var url = base + href; }
     java.log(lis[i].text()+":"+url);
     list.push({"text": text, "href": url});
}

let config = (() => {
    try {
        let cfg = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())[0] || {};
        if (!cfg.host || !cfg.gender) {
            cfg = {gender: "boy", host: getServerHost()};
            source.setVariable(JSON.stringify([cfg]));
            java.toast("配置初始化完成");
        }
        return cfg;
    } catch(e) {
        let cfg = {gender: "boy", host: getServerHost()};
        source.setVariable(JSON.stringify([cfg]));
        return cfg;
    }
})();
    
let rawVariable = source.getVariable();
let 个人中心 = 1;
let obj = (title, url, type) => ({
  title: title,
  url: url,
  style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: type }
});

let sort = [];
let push = (title, url, type) => sort.push(obj(title, url, type));

let currentType = "";
let currentSource = "";
try {
  let vArray = JSON.parse(rawVariable);
  if (vArray.length > 0) {
    let v = vArray[0];
    currentType = v.gender || "";
    currentSource = v.source || "";
    
    if (currentSource == "推荐") {
      currentType = "recommend";
      v.gender = "recommend";
      source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(vArray));
    } else if (currentType == "recommend") {
      currentType = "boy";
      v.gender = "boy";
      source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(vArray));
    }
  }
} catch(e) {
  currentType = "";
  currentSource = "";
}

const getGenderDisplayName = (gender) => {
  if (gender == "boy") return "男频";
  if (gender == "girl") return "女频";
  if (gender == "recommend") return "推荐";
  return "";
};

const genderDisplay = getGenderDisplayName(currentType);

push(`当前为【${currentSource || "番茄小说"}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}`, "", 1);

const excludedSources = ["小说", "听书", "漫画", "视频", "短剧", "音频","番茄小说","fqxs"];

if (currentSource && currentSource !== "推荐" && !excludedSources.includes(currentSource)) {
  try {
    let apiUrl = `${getServerHost()}/type_api?source=${currentSource}`;
    if (currentType) {
      apiUrl += `&gender=${currentType}`;
    }
    
    let response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(apiUrl));
    
    if (response.data && response.data.found) {
      response.data.found.forEach(item => {
        let finalUrl = "";
        if (item.url) {
          finalUrl = `${getServerHost()}/type_api?source=${currentSource}&page={{page}}&url=${item.url}`;
          if (currentType) {
            finalUrl += `&gender=${currentType}`;
          }
        }
        sort.push({
          title: item.title,
          url: finalUrl,
          style: item.style || { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
        });
      });
    } else {
      push(`【${currentSource}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}暂无数据`, "", 1);
    }
  } catch(e) {
    push(`【${currentSource}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}暂无数据`, "", 1);
  }
  JSON.stringify(sort);
} else if (currentType == "recommend" && currentSource == "推荐") {
  
  let maleCategories = [];
  try {
    let maleResponse = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/api?action=subcategories&top_category_id=1"));
      maleCategories = maleResponse.data;
  } catch(e) {
    push('男频分类加载失败，请检查网络', "", 1);
  }
  
  let femaleCategories = [];
  try {
    let femaleResponse = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/api?action=subcategories&top_category_id=2"));
femaleCategories = femaleResponse.data;
  } catch(e) {
    push('女频分类加载失败，请检查网络', "", 1);
  }
  
  if (maleCategories.length > 0) {
    push('♂️ 男频推荐 ♂️', "", 1);
    maleCategories.forEach(cat => {
      push(cat.name, `${getServerHost()}/api?action=books&sub_category_id=${cat.id}&limit=20&page={{page}}`, 0.29);
    });
  } else if (maleCategories.length == 0 && !femaleCategories.length == 0 && !femaleCategories.length > 0) {
    push('男频分类暂无数据', "", 1);
  }
  
  if (femaleCategories.length > 0) {
    push('♀️ 女频推荐 ♀️', "", 1);
    femaleCategories.forEach(cat => {
      push(cat.name, `${getServerHost()}/api?action=books&sub_category_id=${cat.id}&limit=20&page={{page}}`, 0.29);
    });
  } else if (femaleCategories.length === 0 && !maleCategories.length > 0) {
    push('女频分类暂无数据', "", 1);
  }
  
  JSON.stringify(sort);
} else {
  let recommendUrl = "https://api5-normal-lf.fqnovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookmall/cell/change/v1/?aid=1967&change_type=1&iid=1&app_name=novelapp&version_code=999&cell_id=7012498777642631182&algo_type=101&category_id=0";
let recommendPost = JSON.stringify({
    headers: { 
    Cookie: "sessionid=" + getSessionId() 
  }
});
  push('个性推荐', recommendUrl + "," + recommendPost, 0.29);
  push('巅峰榜单', 'https://fanqienovel.com/api/author/misc/top_book_list/v1/?limit=100&offset={{(page-1)*100}}', 0.29);
  push('出版榜单', 'https://fanqienovel.com/api/node/publication/list?page_index={{(page-1)*100}}&page_count=100', 0.29);
  push('爆更榜单', 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=15&type=1', 0.29);
  push('黑马榜单', 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=13&type=1', 0.29);
  push('热搜榜单', 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=12&type=1', 0.29);	

  let fqCategoryArr = [];
  let showCategories = currentType === "girl" ? [0] : (currentType == "boy" ? [1] : [0, 1]);

  showCategories.forEach(i => {
    try {
      let response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`${getServerHost()}/type?new_category_tab=${i}`));
      let $ = response.data.category_tab_data;
      
      let tabName = $.tab_name || (i === 0 ? "女频" : "男频");
      fqCategoryArr.push(obj(`❤️${tabName}分类❤️`, null, 1));
      
      $.cell_data.forEach(c => {
        fqCategoryArr.push(obj(c.cell_name, null, 1));
        
        for (let j = 2; j < 5; j++) {
          c.atom_data.slice(1).forEach(a => {
            let d = a.category_data;
            if (d.name.length == j) {
              let gender = i;
              let genre = 0;
              let cid = d.category_id;
              
              fqCategoryArr.push({
                title: d.name,
                url: `${getServerHost()}/type?category_id=${cid}&genre=${genre}&gender=${gender}&limit=20&offset={{(page-1)*100}}`,
                style: {
                  layout_flexGrow: 1,
                  layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29
                }
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      fqCategoryArr.push(obj("分类加载失败，请重试", null, 1));
    }
  });

  fqCategoryArr.forEach(item => sort.push(item));

  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700' 
  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': "sessionid=" + getSessionId()
    }
  })));

  let username;
  if (book_shelf_info.code != 0) {
    个人中心 = 0;
  } else {
    let uinfo = java.ajax("https://fanqienovel.com/api/user/info/v2," + JSON.stringify({ 
      headers: { 
    Cookie: "sessionid=" + getSessionId() 
      }
    }));
    uinfo = JSON.parse(uinfo);
    username = uinfo.data.name;
  }

  let gro = [];
  let pushGro = (title, url, type) => gro.push(obj(title, url, type));

  let sArr = [];

  if (个人中心) {
    let groups_bookids = { "未分组": [] };
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
      if (!groups_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) 
        groups_bookids[i.group_name] = [];
      groups_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id);
    });

      pushGro(k, "https://fanqienovel.com/fqbookshelf/groupName/" + k, 0.4);

    sArr.push(obj(username + '的个人中心', '', 1));
    sArr.push(obj("我的书架", "https://fanqienovel.com/fqbookshelf", 1));

      headers: { 
    Cookie: "sessionid=" + getSessionId()
    }}), 1));
  }

  sort = sArr.concat(sort);
  JSON.stringify(sort);
}

<js>
function getBookIdFull(url) {
    const {java} = this
    $ = JSON.parse(url).data
    if ($.book_shelf_info != 0 && $.book_shelf_info != undefined) {
        arr = $.book_shelf_info.map($ => $.book_id)
    } else if (list = $.data_list != 0 && $.data_list != undefined)  {
        arr = $.data_list.map($ => $.book_id_str)
    } else {
        java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！")
    }
    return arr
}

let ck = "sessionid=" + (String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) ? String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) : (source.getLoginInfoMap() ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {})['手动登录Token'])

getShelf = () => {
    let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
    let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
        headers: {
            'Cookie': ck
        }
    }))

    bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
    let id_list = splitArray(bid, 200)
    let urls = []
    id_list.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })

    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
    let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

    let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
        headers: {
            'Cookie': ck,
        }
    })))
    let group_bookids = {
        "未分组": []
    }
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
        if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
        group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
    })
    
    if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
    
    let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 200)
    let urls = []

    book_ids.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
    let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
        "bookmall/tab",
        "version_name=5.8.9.32",
        null,
        ck
    )
    let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
    let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
    if (!tab) tab = []
    let bookList = []
    for (let i of tab) {
        bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    return { book_info: bookList }
}

function normalizeResponse(data) {
    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.result) return data.data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {
        return data.data.cell_view.book_data;
    }
    if (data.data && data.data.records) return data.data.records;
    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    return [];
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) {
    result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
} else if(/read_history/.test(baseUrl)) {
    bid = getBookIdFull(result);
    id_list = splitArray(bid, 200);
    let urls = [];
    id_list.forEach(i =>{    	urls.push("https://api5-normal-sinfonlineb.fqnovel.com/reading/bookapi/multi-detail/v/?aid=1967&iid=1&version_code=999&book_id=" + i.join(","))
    });
    let resp = {book_info: []}
    urls.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(java.ajax(r)).data)
    })
    result = resp;
} else {
    let w = baseUrl.split("/")
    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
    } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
        result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
    } else {
        result = JSON.parse(result)
        if (result.data && result.data.data) {
            result = {book_info: result.data.data}
        }
    }
}

let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);

JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData})
</js>

<js>
let res = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
let catalog = {
    source: res.source,
    url: res.url,
    name: res.name,
    tab: res.tab || "novel"
};

var tabTips = {audio: '听书', video: '视频', comic: '漫画'}; 
if (tabTips[catalog.tab]) {
    java.toast('当前为' + tabTips[catalog.tab] + '模式');
}

let op = {
    method: "POST",
    body: {
        source: catalog.source,
        url: catalog.url,
        name: catalog.name
    }
};

let catalogUrl = getServerHost() +`/catalog,${JSON.stringify(op)}`;
let response = java.ajax(catalogUrl);

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

let device = deviceType() ? 'android' : 'ios';

if (device == 'android') {
    var typeMap = {audio:32, comic:64};
    book.type = catalog.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[catalog.tab] : 8;
} else {
    var typeMap = {audio:1, comic:2, video:3};
    book.type = catalog.tab in typeMap ? typeMap[catalog.tab] : 0;
}

JSON.parse(response).data.map((x) => {
    const isFanqieApp = ['番茄小说', '番茄短剧', '番茄听书', '番茄畅听'].includes(catalog.source);
    const urlToMatch = x.url || catalog.url;
    const bookId = urlToMatch.match(/book_id=(\d{19})\b/)?.[1] || null;
    const itemId = urlToMatch.match(/item_id=(\d+)/)?.[1] || null;
    
    let contentUrl = getServerHost() + `/chapter?cid=${x.cid}&source=${catalog.source}`;
    
    if (!isFanqieApp) {
        contentUrl += `&url=${catalog.url}`;
    } else {
        contentUrl += `&book_id=${bookId}&item_id=${itemId}`;
        
        if (['番茄听书', '番茄畅听'].includes(catalog.source)) {
            const toneId = Number((source.getLoginInfoMap())['听书AI音色编号']) || 1;
            contentUrl += `&tone_id=${toneId}`;
        }
    }
    
    if (catalog.source == '番茄小说') {
        const commentPart = `{"js":"book ? result : '${getServerHost()}/comment?sessionid=${getSessionId()}&item_id=${itemId}&book_id=${bookId}'"}`;
        x.url = `${contentUrl},${commentPart}`;
    } else {
        x.url = contentUrl;
    }
    
    return x;
});
</js>

}

(() => {
	try {
		data = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())
	} catch (err) {
		data = {}
	}
	sessionID = data.sessionID||"";
	if (!sessionID) {
		chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456789";
		charsLength = chars.length
		for (i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
			sessionID += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charsLength))
		}
		data.sessionID = sessionID
		source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(data))
	}
	return JSON.stringify({
		"cookie": "PHPSESSID=" + sessionID,
		"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 13_3_1 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/13.0.5 Mobile/15E148 Snapchat/10.77.5.59 (like Safari/604.1)"
	})
})()
</js>

list=[];
d.forEach((s, index)=>{

<js>
try{
form=java.getElement("#content label")
txt=java.getElement("#content [class=001] p")
while (form!=""){
	code=String(java.getString("strong@textNodes",form)).trim()
	java.log(code)
	result=java.ajax(`${baseUrl},{"body":"captcha=${code}","method":"POST"}`)
	java.setContent(result)
	form=java.getElement("#content form")
	}
b64=result.match(/atob\('([^']+)'\)/)[1]
if(result.match(/'aes'\s*===\s*'aes'/)){
	key=result.match(/CryptoJS\.enc\.Base64\.parse\('([^']+)'\)/)[1]
	
	txt+=java.createSymmetricCrypto("AES/ECB/Pkcs7Padding", java.base64DecodeToByteArray(key)).decryptStr(b64)
	}else{
		txt+=java.base64Decode(b64)
		
		}
result=txt}catch{result="\n这章正文不存在！！！\n换一章！！！\n或者\n换本书！！！\n或者\n换源！！！"}
</js>
